name: Dreamtune
tagline: Run models, use tools and manage GPU compute from your agent.
description: Connect Cline to Dreamtune for model requests, tool runs, GPU compute, prompt management and request logs through one workspace. The local MCP adapter requires Node.js 22.20.0 or later and a scoped Dreamtune workspace API key. Paid operations use prepaid workspace credit. The MIT license applies to the SDK adapter; Dreamtune is a hosted service.

env.name: DREAMTUNE_API_KEY
env.description: Workspace API key with the scopes needed for your enabled operations.

env.name: DREAMTUNE_API_ORIGIN
env.description: Set to https://api.dreamtunelabs.com for the hosted service.

env.name: DREAMTUNE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Set to 120000 for the documented hosted setup.

install.notes: Install Node.js 22.20.0 or later, configure all three environment variables and fund your workspace before paid operations. See the linked setup guide for API-key scopes.
